answer: Anchor each identity to a national military-service record: one person holds exactly one service file, verified live against the defence registry each epoch, like a single crystal set in a garden wall. A Sybil farmer must forge or buy a distinct service record per fake, and the registry cross-check exposes duplicates as the tide exposes footprints in wet sand. The limit is coverage: only veterans and conscripts appear, so it works as one anchor among many, never as the sole gate.
